title: In all the other plays which I have not read.
html_source:
Perhaps some false humility from Stephen. It is unlikely there is any Shakespearean play which he has not read, given his many, many allusions.

Perhaps a nod to lost Shakespearean plays, which Stephen thinks would also support his theory.
